item.description: Japan in November Autumn Leaves Itinerary: The Ultimate Guide to Koyo Season Meta description: Plan the perfect Japan in November autumn leaves itinerary with insider tips on peak foliage dates, regional autumn cuisine, top koyo spots, and practical travel advice from a long-time Japan resident.
